title: Pingle
description: A mod that helps you send pings to your friends.
body: Pingle is a lightweight Fabric mod that lets players notify each other with a sound and a customizable chat message using; ``` /pingle ``` 🔔 Sends a sound + styled chat notification to the target player 🎨 Message formatting uses QuickText syntax ([see Patbox's placeholders](https://placeholders.pb4.eu/)) for colors, styles, and placeholders. ✅ Supports [LuckPerms](https://modrinth.com/plugin/luckperms)/[StyledChat](https://modrinth.com/mod/styled-chat) formatting (prefixes, suffixes, colors, etc.) ⚙️ Easy JSON config at config/pingle.json 📂 You can restore default config file by copying this. ``` { "pingleMessage": "🔔 You have been pingled by %player:displayname%! 🔔", "feedbackMessage": "✔ %player:displayname% has been pingled.", "soundPitch": 0.8, "soundVolume": 1.0 } ```
